eod.conclusion: Indian equities closed lower after failing to hold early gains, with the Nifty and Sensex both declining while Bank Nifty eked out a slight advance. Market sentiment wavered as participants weighed corporate earnings against macroeconomic concerns, though reduced volatility provided some support. The rupee faced pressure from regulatory changes, while global markets remained cautious ahead of key central bank decisions and amid persistent inflation fears.
